Dexter

Dexter will stay on the small side of medium.

Cat, dog and child friendly.

He is super friendly and a favourite of every person he meets.

Hobbies include tummy rubs, walking and playing with his friends.

Neutered, fully vaccinated and has his passport ready to travel.

Brucellosis tested negative

Home check and adoption fee applies

Could Dexter be part of your family?

Adopting a rescue dog is a big decision, and potentially the beginning of something wonderful.

If you've read Dexter's story and think you could offer the home they need, we'd love to hear from you.

Our adoption team will get to know you, talk through any questions and make sure the match feels right for everyone.
